findings.detail: Original native-anchor-failures-r1 omitted spatial_tile_key on its .pNNN manifest entries, correctly refused by new loader. Road worker created r2 with explicit cell metadata; no loader validation weakened.

code_review: Encoded local positions are retained; exact projected anchors translate native bodies and visual batches. Groups use identical source-anchor keys only.
Default per-feature path remains available; aggregate bodies split bounded native face counts without mixing anchors or dropping source-face range provenance.
Caps are selected in code by fixed source surface class, with mode-bit and original steps-type corroboration. Numeric file caps are checked for equality, not used as new permissions.
Visible steps use their separate declared arrays; walking collision keeps its inclined contract. Visible face winding is checked separately, while walking normals/triangles retain fixed class caps.

Part names must carry explicit cell identity and round-trip to exactly three digits; ordinals must be contiguous without unsplit/part mixtures. Native structural manifest negatives include signed zero.

SourceWorld iterates every requested cell part, collects every native body, then adds one cell group. It does not register just the first part. Production pin remains recovered R5; typed prototype is not adopted.
Existing resource.changed invalidation and native RID/shape/space/source-origin guards are preserved.
